parameters.source:
{
  render: (args: ButtonStoryArgs) => ({
    components: {
      StoryVariantGrid,
      StoryVariantSection,
      Button
    },
    setup() {
      return {
        args,
        styleTypes,
        styleSizes,
        colors
      };
    },
    template: `
      <StoryVariantGrid>
        <StoryVariantSection v-for="styleType in styleTypes" :key="styleType" :title="styleType">
          <Button
            v-for="color in colors"
            :key="styleType + '-' + color"
            :as="args.as"
            :color="color"
            :disabled="args.disabled"
            :is-loading="args.isLoading"
            :style-size="args.styleSize"
            :style-type="styleType"
          >
            {{ color }}
          </Button>
        </StoryVariantSection>

        <StoryVariantSection title="sizes">
          <Button
            v-for="styleSize in styleSizes"
            :key="styleSize"
            :as="args.as"
            :color="args.color"
            :disabled="args.disabled"
            :is-loading="args.isLoading"
            :style-size="styleSize"
            :style-type="args.styleType"
          >
            {{ styleSize }}
          </Button>
        </StoryVariantSection>
      </StoryVariantGrid>
    `
  })
}
